correctness.rationale: The quadratic Hamiltonian and zero-temperature Lindblad loss yield the displayed real drift A with invariant (q_c,p_h) and (p_c,q_h) 2x2 blocks, characteristic polynomials lambda^2+(d-Omega)lambda+g^2 and lambda^2+(d+Omega)lambda+g^2. For g>0, 0<Omega<d=gamma/2 both are strictly Hurwitz, so the covariance Lyapunov ODE has a unique stable fixed point. Direct substitution proves V_inf=diag(v+,v-,v-,v+), v+=d/[2(d-Omega)], v-=d/[2(d+Omega)], whose cross block is exactly zero; the zero-mean stationary Gaussian state factorizes and has occupation Omega^2/[2(d^2-Omega^2)]>0. The exact covariance flow V(t)=V_inf+e^{At}(I/2-V_inf)e^{A^Tt} gives charger squeezes O(t), off-block correlations -g Omega t^2/2[[0,1],[1,0]]+O(t^3), and local determinants 1/4+O(t^3). Local symplectic reduction and Gaussian PPT eigenvalue expansion give nu_tilde_- =1/2-g Omega t^2/2+O(t^3), hence E_N=g Omega t^2+O(t^3). Since limiting PPT eigenvalue sqrt(v+v-)=d/[2sqrt(d^2-Omega^2)] is strictly >1/2, continuity plus exponential covariance convergence gives one finite T beyond which entanglement never returns. A NEW independent matrix-exponential computation verified the Lyapunov residual (<=5.6e-17), Hurwitz condition, four sample small-time coefficients and stationary strict PPT gaps; these finite samples corroborate, not establish, the arbitrary-parameter analytic result.

This is a mathematically meaningful model classification beyond a routine parameter substitution, while not asserting a unique first death time or generic baths.
